name: process-page
title: Process page
description: The steps of a planning cycle in order — each opens its Lens or app — with live counts and a done / still-to-do state worked out from the data. No submit buttons, no states to maintain.

settings.heading: The process name, e.g. Budget 2027
settings.subtitle: One line under it
settings.note: A short note, e.g. the timetable (optional)
settings.steps: [{ title, lens, who, groups, counts: [{ label, mdx }], remaining: { label, mdx } }] — in order; remaining: when its count is 0 the step shows Done; groups marks the step as the viewer's own

example.heading: Budget 2027
example.subtitle: Year 2 · the steps in order
example.note: Targets by 1 Nov · budgets by 15 Nov · capex approved by 30 Nov.

counts.label: requests
counts.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)} ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])

counts.label: approved
counts.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY FILTER({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)}, [Capital].[Capital].[Approved] = "Y") ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])

remaining.label: {n} waiting
remaining.mdx: SELECT {[Capital].[Capital].[Purchase Cost]} ON 0, NON EMPTY FILTER({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([organization].[organization])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([CapitalList].[CapitalList])},0)} * {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({TM1SUBSETALL([Asset Types].[Asset Types])},0)}, [Capital].[Capital].[Approved] <> "Y") ON 1 FROM [Capital] WHERE ([Year].[Year].[Y2],[Version].[Version].[Target])
